# LELO-TEMP TinyTapeout delivery

The analog temperature sensor tile, wrapped for TinyTapeout.

* `tt_um_lelo_temp_wulffern` is generated by
  `design/LELO_TEMP_SKY130A/gen_tt_um.py` -- the port row comes from
  `tt_block_1x1_pg.def`, never from a hand copy (the template mag in
  this repo was mirrored against the DEF; the generator reads the DEF).
* Build and verify from `work/`:

      make mag  CELL=LELO_TEMP           # the core
      python3 ../design/LELO_TEMP_SKY130A/gen_tt_um.py
      make drc gds kdrc CELL=tt_um_lelo_temp_wulffern
      make cdl_tt                        # tt netlist ([] ports, <> tree)
      make lvs  CELL=tt_um_lelo_temp_wulffern

* ui_in[0] = PWRUP_ANA (antenna diode on the route), uo_out[0] =
  OSC_TEMP. uio_oe[7:0] tied low through res_generic_m4, so every uio
  pin is an input. All other pins are unconnected pads.
